summary: Multiselect specced and its design corrected in Paper, but NOT implemented: it is the first component whose behaviour is the hard part (collision-aware popover positioning, focus management and restoration, listbox/combobox ARIA, typeahead, outside-click dismissal) and plan §7.6 — the behaviour-layer decision — is still open with no ADR and no dependency in the tree. Hand-rolling it would produce a component that looks right in Storybook, passes every gate this repo has, and fails a real screen-reader user, which is exactly what the review method exists to prevent. Recorded the full corrected spec plus the dependency order in design/paper/multiselect-blocked.md: close §7.6, then Checkbox (designed and buildable today), then Popover (shared by Select/Menu/Tooltip/Combobox), then Multiselect composing Input as trigger, Badge as chips and Checkbox as rows. Two of those four primitives now exist.

migration.manual: None — nothing shipped. Unblocks with the §7.6 ADR.
